dedupe_keys.name: urbanrail net world guide to metro subway tram and light rail systems with city overviews and network maps

description: UrbanRail.Net is a website that describes itself as a gateway to information on metros, subways, trams, light rail and similar urban rail transit systems around the world. For each city it gives a general overview of the metro system and links to other relevant sites, organised by Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa and Oceania, with a news section and a book list. Coverage: cities worldwide, with separate pages for major systems such as London, Paris, Moscow, New York City, Mexico City and Buenos Aires. Format and access: HTML pages, funded by advertising; free to view. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: this is an enthusiast reference site maintained outside any transit agency; figures and maps may lag behind the operators' own; there is no structured data download, and the city pages themselves were not opened. Simulation uses: a quick reference to the extent and history of urban rail networks when building transit network models where operators publish little. Related records: OpenRailwayMap (data-openrailwaymap) is a structured, open map of railway infrastructure.
